response.sql:
WITH race_name_averages AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg
  FROM race_name_averages
)
SELECT a.race_name, a.avg_points, a.avg_points - o.overall_avg AS difference
FROM race_name_averages AS a
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE a.avg_points > o.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted average of the per-race-name averages, so each distinct race name contributes equally.
